summary: C&F Financial Corp filed an 8-K to announce the sale of its membership interest in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC to an unaffiliated third party, effective May 1, 2026. The company estimates a pre-tax gain of approximately $8.3 million. Concurrently, it executed a strategic restructuring of its available-for-sale securities portfolio, selling $72.6 million (1.40% yield) and purchasing $67.8 million (4.70% yield), resulting in a pre-tax loss of $7.1 million, recoverable over 3.3 years. The board recommended the transaction; no advisor named. Watch for second-quarter 2026 financial impact showing net benefit from the paired transactions.
